tu.title: Tutor
tu.pitch: The tutor comes with Darsi Super: ask anything about your lessons, by voice or in writing, in Egyptian Arabic or English.
tu.fromLesson: Open a lesson and tap “Ask the tutor” to talk about it.
tu.talkData: Talking uses about 0.5 MB a minute and more credits than typing.
tu.hint: Ask about this lesson: a word you didn't get, an example, or how to use it in class.
tu.speaking: The tutor is speaking. Speak to interrupt.
tu.closed: The tutor isn't open yet. Please try later.
tu.needSuper: The tutor comes with Darsi Super.
tu.mic: Darsi can't use the microphone. Allow it in the browser, or type instead.
tu.time: That conversation reached its time limit. Start again to carry on.
tu.offline: Connect to the internet to use the tutor.
tu.error: The tutor didn't answer. Try again in a minute.
tu.explainerFailed: The explainer can't play here. The answer above covers it.
